Contributing to heimdall

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Development environment

The repository has a development container (.devcontainer/devcontainer.json) based on R 4.6.1 with the Python backend of daltoolboxdp (torch, numpy, pandas, scikit-learn). In VS Code, run Dev Containers: Reopen in Container.

Git hook

Enable the pre-commit hook once per clone:

git config core.hooksPath .githooks

It rejects staged files whose names cannot be checked out on Windows (for example names containing :) and files that still hold merge conflict markers. The repository-checks workflow runs the same checks on every push.

Code style and documentation

  • Style the code with styler::style_pkg(); lintr::lint_package() must report no lints, since the lint workflow fails on any.
  • Documentation is written with roxygen2 8.1.1 (pinned in DESCRIPTION). Run roxygen2::roxygenise() after changing roxygen comments and commit the regenerated man/ and NAMESPACE.
  • README.md is generated from README.Rmd with rmarkdown::render("README.Rmd").

Examples

Every drifter has a detection example and an online prediction example. The sources are the .Rmd files under Rmd/examples/; the files under examples/ (.md, doc/, fig/, r/) are generated from them. Edit the sources and regenerate everything with:

Rscript Rmd/conversor.R

The AEDD examples need the Python backend, so run the conversion in the development container. The python-backend workflow renders every example on each push and fails if one of them breaks.

Tests

Run the test suite with testthat::test_local(). The statistical tests (false alarms and detection delay across seeds) and the AEDD tests with the real autoencoder are skipped on CRAN; set NOT_CRAN=true to run them.

Data

The raw flight datasets used by data-gen/ are not versioned. Place them in data-real/ before running the generator scripts.
